newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine Feb industrial output falls 6.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine Feb industrial output falls 6.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Industrial output in Ukraine was 6.5-percent lower in February than a year earlier against January's revised 7.5-percent decline, the Statistics Ministry said on Thursday.
UKRAINE INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT FEB 97 JAN 97 FEB 96
The ministry had previously reported January down 12.2 percent, with a year-on-year fall of 8.1 percent.
Industrial output in the first two months of this year was 6.8-percent lower than a year earlier.
The government has forecast industrial growth of one percent in 1997 after a 5.1-percent fall in 1996.
